title: HB1286 (2019-2020 Regular): Banning the sale of assault weapons and large capacity magazines.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2019-20/Htm/Bills/House%20Bills/1286.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version. Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.010) adds definitions of assault weapon, copycat weapon and large capacity magazine (long model list, not quoted). Sec. 2(3) limits where grandfathered owners may possess them. Sec. 4 severability. Sec. 3 covers assault weapons only, not magazines.

operative_text:
NEW SECTION Sec. 2 (new RCW section, chapter 9.41): (1) No person in this state may manufacture, possess, distribute, import, transfer, sell, offer for sale, purchase, or otherwise transfer any assault weapon or large capacity magazine except as authorized in this section.
NEW SECTION Sec. 2 (new RCW section, chapter 9.41): (a) The possession of an assault weapon or large capacity magazine by a person who legally possessed the assault weapon or large capacity magazine on the effective date of this section, or possession of an assault weapon or large capacity magazine by a person who, on or after the effective date of this section, acquires possession of the assault weapon or large capacity magazine by operation of law upon the death of the former owner who was in legal possession of the assault weapon or large capacity magazine, provided the person in possession of the assault weapon or large capacity magazine can establish such provenance.
NEW SECTION Sec. 2 (new RCW section, chapter 9.41): (4) A person who violates this section is guilty of a class C felony punishable under chapter  9A.20 RCW.
NEW SECTION Sec. 3 (new RCW section, chapter 9.41): (1) Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, a person shall not:
NEW SECTION Sec. 3 (new RCW section, chapter 9.41): (a) Transport an assault weapon into Washington state; or
NEW SECTION Sec. 3 (new RCW section, chapter 9.41): (b) Possess, sell, offer to sell, transfer, purchase, or receive an assault weapon.
